{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792985235981,"sessionID":"ses_e89c1973effewSmv91SoOTQ6VY","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"edit","callID":"toolu_01CaxvqFxxBVdrkFmsvSDHor","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","oldString":"void floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, \n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, \n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm\n    // For each intermediate node k\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // For each source node i\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            // For each destination node j\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;\n                \n                if (newDist < distIJ) {\n                    dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = newDist;\n                    path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}","newString":"// One Floyd-Warshall relaxation step for intermediate node k.\n// Each thread owns one (i, j) entry. Row k and column k are never modified during\n// step k (the diagonal is 0, so dist[k][k] + x < x never holds), so every thread\n// reads the same values the sequential algorithm would read, and no races occur.\n__global__ void floydWarshallStepKernel(unsigned int* __restrict__ dist,\n                                        unsigned int* __restrict__ path,\n                                        const size_t numNodes,\n                                        const size_t k) {\n    const size_t j = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.y) * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;\n    if (i >= numNodes || j >= numNodes) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n    const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n    const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;\n\n    const size_t ij = idx2(j, i, numNodes);\n    if (newDist < dist[ij]) {\n        dist[ij] = newDist;\n        path[ij] = static_cast<unsigned int>(k);\n    }\n}\n\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, \n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, \n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    if (numNodes == 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const size_t count = numNodes * numNodes;\n    const size_t bytes = count * sizeof(unsigned int);\n\n    unsigned int* dDist = nullptr;\n    unsigned int* dPath = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dDist, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPath, bytes));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dDist, dist.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPath, path.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const dim3 block(BLOCK_X, BLOCK_Y);\n    const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned int>((numNodes + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X),\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>((numNodes + BLOCK_Y - 1) / BLOCK_Y));\n\n    // Steps k must run in order; launches on the same stream execute sequentially.\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        floydWarshallStepKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dDist, dPath, numNodes, k);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dist.data(), dDist, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(path.data(), dPath, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dDist));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPath));\n}"},"output":"Edit applied successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"diff":"Index: /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp\n===================================================================\n--- /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp\n+++ /home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp\n@@ -56,31 +56,66 @@\n         path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;\n     }\n }\n \n+// One Floyd-Warshall relaxation step for intermediate node k.\n+// Each thread owns one (i, j) entry. 1) / BLOCK_X),\n+                    static_cast<unsigned int>((numNodes + BLOCK_Y - 1) / BLOCK_Y));\n+\n+    // Steps k must run in order; launches on the same stream execute sequentially.\n     for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n-        // For each source node i\n-        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n-            // For each destination node j\n-            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n-                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n-                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n-                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n-                \n-                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;\n-                \n-                if (newDist < distIJ) {\n-                    dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = newDist;\n-                    path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = k;\n-                }\n-            }\n-        }\n+        floydWarshallStepKernel<<<grid, block>>>(dDist, dPath, numNodes, k);\n     }\n+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n+\n+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dist.data(), dDist, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(path.data(), dPath, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n+\n+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dDist));\n+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPath));\n }\n \n bool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n     // Basic sanity checks\n","additions":53,"deletions":18},"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","time":{"start":1792985235949,"end":1792985235975}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_1763f6f8b001dB37l28yyjcspb","sessionID":"ses_e89c1973effewSmv91SoOTQ6VY","messageID":"msg_1763f3447001WxrQ2xLhRlEvtZ"}}
{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792985237910,"sessionID":"ses_e89c1973effewSmv91SoOTQ6VY","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01XZKdbhN73qTZjFCeKPJajv","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt","content":"cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)\nproject(floydwarshall_benchmark LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\n# Build for the GPUs present on the machine unless the user overrides it\nif(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES native)\nendif()\n\nfind_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)\n\nadd_executable(floydwarshall floydwarshall.cpp)\n\n# The implementation is CUDA; compile the .cpp source with nvcc\nset_source_files_properties(floydwarshall.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\n# Enable optimizations (host flags forwarded through nvcc)\ntarget_compile_options(floydwarshall PRIVATE\n    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3 -Xcompiler=-march=native -Xcompiler=-Wall -Xcompiler=-Wextra>)\n\n# Link CUDA runtime and math library\ntarget_link_libraries(floydwarshall PRIVATE CUDA::cudart m)\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt","time":{"start":1792985237820,"end":1792985237857}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_1763f81f3001X49PsVhRrb741S","sessionID":"ses_e89c1973effewSmv91SoOTQ6VY","messageID":"msg_1763f3447001WxrQ2xLhRlEvtZ"}}

{"type":"text","timestamp":1792985378183,"sessionID":"ses_e89c1973effewSmv91SoOTQ6VY","part":{"id":"prt_17641ad58001WuP7N9H8O5ai1K","messageID":"msg_176419ae5001Vxlnt6H60Pm89A","sessionID":"ses_e89c1973effewSmv91SoOTQ6VY","type":"text","text":"The architecture is still `sm_52`. {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1792985381165,"sessionID":"ses_e89c1973effewSmv91SoOTQ6VY","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01Au12maV96DM5VdkmkSEHxy","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt","content":"cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)\n\n# Generate device code for common modern GPU architectures unless the user overrides it\n# with -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=... (must be set before project(): CMake otherwise\n# pre-populates the variable with the nvcc default, which is sm_52 on some toolkits).\nif(NOT CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 75 80 86 89)\nendif()\n\nproject(floydwarshall_benchmark LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\nfind_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)\n\nadd_executable(floydwarshall floydwarshall.cpp)\n\n# The implementation is CUDA; compile the .cpp source with nvcc\nset_source_files_properties(floydwarshall.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\n# Enable optimizations (host flags forwarded through nvcc)\ntarget_compile_options(floydwarshall PRIVATE\n    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3 -Xcompiler=-march=native -Xcompiler=-Wall -Xcompiler=-Wextra>)\n\n# Link CUDA runtime and math library\ntarget_link_libraries(floydwarshall PRIVATE CUDA::cudart m)\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r2/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt","time":{"start":1792985381095,"end":1792985381123}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_17641b155001rHRUcuQCE3l2EZ","sessionID":"ses_e89c1973effewSmv91SoOTQ6VY","messageID":"msg_17641ad9f001z60wRkds0MYoo1"}}
